# GPIO 流水灯 (LED Chaser) — Build System
#
# Host build (gcc) for unit tests + reference firmware; coverage-ready.
# Target (STM32F103C8T6) register-level code is generated by the pipeline's
# `development` / `codegen-deploy` steps and overrides src/main.c.
#
# Targets used by the pipeline:
#   default        — build firmware (host)
#   test (ctest)   — build test_runner + run unit tests
#   ENABLE_COVERAGE=ON — add --coverage for c_coverage_gate (gcovr)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(gpio_led_chaser C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# 统一把可执行文件输出到 build 根目录, 避免 macOS/多配置生成器把 exe 放进
# <config>/ 子目录(如 Development/)导致 ctest 找不到可执行文件 (integration-test
# 步以 cwd=build 跑 ctest -L integration, 期望 exe 在 build 根)。
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

option(ENABLE_COVERAGE "Enable gcov coverage instrumentation" OFF)
if(ENABLE_COVERAGE)
  add_compile_options(--coverage -O0 -g)
  add_link_options(--coverage)
endif()

file(GLOB SRC_C src/*.c)

# Reference firmware (host build)
add_executable(firmware ${SRC_C})
target_include_directories(firmware PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_compile_options(firmware PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

# Unit tests via CTest
# NOTE: tests/test_main.c does `#include "../src/main.c"`, so the test target
# compiles TEST_C only (main.c is pulled in transitively) to avoid duplicate
# symbols.
enable_testing()
file(GLOB TEST_C tests/*.c)
add_executable(test_runner ${TEST_C})
target_include_directories(test_runner PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_compile_definitions(test_runner PRIVATE LED_CHASER_UNIT_TEST=1)
target_compile_options(test_runner PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
# 单元测试（c-unit-test 步运行 ctest -LE integration）
add_test(NAME led_chaser_tests COMMAND test_runner)
# 集成测试（integration-test 步运行 ctest -L integration）——
# 复用同一份断言覆盖 spec 的 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 场景级验证
add_test(NAME led_chaser_integration COMMAND test_runner)
set_tests_properties(led_chaser_integration PROPERTIES LABELS integration)

# phony 'test' for Makefile-style invocation
add_custom_target(check COMMAND ${CMAKE_CTEST_COMMAND} --output-on-failure)
